Results.Title: My second Weber

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill a few months ago and it has performed exactly as I had hoped. The grill is consistent at providing even heat across the entire surface with one exception. One of the drawbacks I noticed is when the wind picked up the grill had difficulty getting up to temperature and the wind would actually blow out the flames if set to medium or lower. The other design problem I had with the grill is the ease of mobility. The instructions tell you to lock the folding shelf in place and use that as a handle but I would strongly discourage this unless you want to damage your grill. The folding shelf is not made to handle the weight of the grill and a propane tank. If you lift it by this then the shelf will slide out of it's locked position and damage the shelf while also dropping your grill which may damage the more fragile components like the ignition system. Since I roll my grill around quite a bit I have to grab it by the frame which is much lower and awkward so this can be a major annoyance. Other than these two problems I have experienced, I am satisfied with the grill's performance and hope that it will last for many years.
